inventory.description: Pure, host-testable modules (Packages/VisualCore): Math, Simulation (SceneClock, FixedStepClock, SeededRandom, AccessibilityPreferences), Scenes (PointerTracker, ExportGeometry), ShaderSource, EffectsGraph, Diagnostics (FramePacing), Parameters, Persistence, TestSupport (+ placeholder AudioDSP). iOS modules (Packages/VisualCoreRendering): Rendering, Effects, UI, Automation (Debug/measurement) (+ placeholder Audio). Rules R1-R5 enforced by scripts/check_dependencies.py.

RenderHost owns the EGL display/context/surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend, a CAMetalLayer RenderView, a frame scheduler and context generations. All GL work runs on the main thread (@MainActor; dispatchPrecondition in DEBUG). pause/resume, recreateContext (context loss) and destroy; scenes implement RenderScene setup/resize/render/teardown.

ResourceRegistry creates textures, buffers, render targets and programs under a ResourceBudget, pools render targets, caches programs, counts leaks and rejects stale handles after a generation change.

ShaderLibrary expands includes and defines with line maps; ResourceRegistry.program compiles/links through ANGLE and reports ShaderDiagnostic file:line; color-space policy in docs/rendering/color-space.md.
Versioned effect-graph description, validator (≤ 32 passes, memory quota) and GPU executor with 8 pass types; EffectScene wraps any scene and adds the Reduce Flashing limiter.

Pointer tracking and tap/drag/pinch/rotate recognizers, scene graph and mesh generators; fixed-step clock, seeded RNG, timelines/tweens and particle system; primitive/particle/mesh renderers and the UIKit touch adapter.

XcodeGen 2.46.0 specs (root project.yml for Showcase and app targets; harness specs), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, unsigned simulator builds, scripts/release_check.py (30 steps) and CI.
Reference pinned at d93edd1 (ADR-0005), read-only; baseline steps via scripts/run_reference_baseline.py, read-only check scripts/check_reference_clean.py, ProjectMReference harness tests.
Apps own product composition, content and one-off rules (Apps/<Name>/); VisualCore owns reusable logic (constitution 1.2.0 Principle II 'Maximize reuse'); ProjectM stays in the harness (R1).
VisualCoreTestSupport (test targets only): ImageComparison/ImageDifference/ImageStatistics for pixel tests (A01-P01).

inventory.area: Render targets, formats and pooling (fluid fields)
inventory.description: ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget(width:height:format:label:) creates an FBO with one color texture (TextureFormat rgba8/rgba16f/r8), checks completeness (ResourceError.incompleteFramebuffer) and accounts bytes against ResourceBudget; acquireTarget/recycle pool targets; RenderTarget.bind/bindColor/readPixels. No ping-pong pair type and no half-float capability query yet.

The effect graph's 'feedback' pass keeps a history target across frames (runner internal; public surface EffectRenderer/EffectScene over EffectGraphDescription). FullScreenShaderScene draws one bundled fragment shader with u_time/u_resolution/u_seed/u_palette/u_<param> uniforms; ShaderBundle loads app shaders with the vc/*.glsl library.

RenderView turns UIKit touches into PointerEvents (id, phase, position in points); PointerTracker keeps active pointers; tap/drag/pinch recognizers in VisualCoreScenes. No per-pointer velocity or rate-capped resampling yet.

inventory.area: Frame pacing, thermal state and time
inventory.description: FramePacing derives max FPS and render scale from thermal state and Low Power Mode (applied by RenderHost's FrameScheduler); SceneClock (play/pause/scrub/rate), FixedStepClock (fixed simulation steps), SeededRandom (xoshiro256**).

RenderHost.renderOffscreen + StillImageEncoder (opaque sRGB PNG) + ExportGeometry (A01-P04); release tooling shared by every app: check_privacy_manifest.py, check_app_release.py, bundle_licenses.py, AutomationView, AcknowledgementsView (A01-P06).

matrix.notes: Closed in A02-P01 (G-PINGPONG): PingPongTarget swaps read/write targets with budget accounting and idempotent release; FieldPass refuses to sample its output (inputIsOutput). Verified by PingPongTargetTests/FieldPassTests and the app dissipation fixture on iOS 27.2 and 26.5. A02-P04: FieldPass.runObserver (VisualCore) audits whole frames: 2,340 runs over 60 frames, 0 sampled their own output (PassIsolationTests).
The 'feedback' pass type keeps display history across frames; simulation fields use M01.

Closed in A02-P01 (G-FIELDPASS, G-CPUFIELD): FieldPass runs a program with named sampler inputs and typed uniforms into a target or framebuffer; FieldGrid/StoragePrecision give a precision-matched CPU reference (half-float writes truncate on the simulators, so float16TowardZero exists); TimeStepPolicy bounds the step. The solver equations stay app-local (G-SOLVER, M04).

A02-P02/P03: semi-Lagrangian advection, splats, implicit viscosity, divergence, Jacobi pressure and projection with walls/open edges are implemented app-local by the A02 rule (FluidShaders with CPU references Advection, Splat and FluidSolver in FluidArtPlaygroundCore), on reusable VisualCore machinery (FieldPass, PingPongTarget, vc/field.glsl = FieldGrid.sampleBilinear). GPU equals CPU on 8x8 and 16x16 in both storages on iOS 27.2 and 26.5; 0 out-of-grid reads. The model is artistic, not physical.

Closed in A02-P02 (G-POINTERVEL): PointerVelocityTracker resamples each finger at a spacing with a smoothed velocity, caps work per update and rejects invalid input; the app SplatQueue turns samples into capped splats; contentSwipeBackDisabled keeps paint drags from the iOS 26 content swipe-back.

Palettes (exact sRGB, linear sampling) and bloom/composite/color-matrix passes. A02-P04: the Glowing dye palette uses VisualCore EffectScene with the bloom pass (bypassed for Ink and Smoke) and the flash limiter under Reduce Flashing (PlaygroundModel).

matrix.capability: Configurable simulation resolution with thermal downgrade
matrix.notes: Closed in A02-P03 (G-QUALITY): QualityPolicy steps tiers down on serious/critical thermal state or Low Power above a ceiling and up after a calm period, at most once per decision interval; the app maps tiers to pressure iterations first, then the splat cap (FluidQuality). Real thermal behavior is measured in campaign II. A02-P05 adds the user-facing Simulation detail picker (FluidDetail: 64², 128², 256², device-capped; field-only rebuild with fallback).

matrix.capability: Pause, reset and deterministic seeded test mode
matrix.notes: Play/pause/scrub clock, fixed simulation steps and a seeded RNG. A02-P05: the playground's Pause/Step/Reset (SimulationControl, scene requestStep/resetFields) and the deterministic test mode (fixed 1/60 s, tier pinned, VisualCore SyntheticGestureScript; byte-identical pictures for the same seed on iOS 27.2 and 26.5). Device runs use AutomationRunner modes with VISUALCORE_AUTORUN_SEED and the post-run field check (G-AUTOCHECK).

Offscreen render on the host's context, opaque sRGB PNG, capped sizes (A01-P04). A02-P04: still capture reuses RenderHost.renderOffscreen, ExportGeometry and StillImageEncoder with the scene paused (CaptureModel); share via the system share sheet with NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription.

Closed in A02-P01 (G-FLOATRT): the support query needs the color-buffer float extension and a working RGBA16F probe (both true on the iOS 27.2 and 26.5 simulators); RGBA8 fallback with signed-range velocity encoding is tested by forcing it. Device support is recorded in campaign II.

gaps.test: PingPongTarget simulator tests: swap alternates read/write targets, binding the read target as the write target is rejected (A02 rule), both targets are budget-accounted and released with 0 leaks after context loss; app fixture: uniform dye at rest decays only by the configured dissipation
RenderCapabilities half-float render-target support query agrees with a framebuffer-completeness probe on both simulator runtimes; a forced 'unsupported' path selects the documented RGBA8 fallback
FieldPass simulator tests: a program with named sampler inputs renders into a target with typed uniforms, rejects an input that is also the output, and matches a CPU-computed result on a tiny grid

App-domain solver: advection and splats done in A02-P02 (GPU = CPU reference on 8x8 and 16x16, both storages, both runtimes; AdvectionFixtureTests, SplatFixtureTests); divergence, Jacobi pressure and projection in Phase 03 against the same CPU-reference standard; kept in the app by the A02 rule (artistic model, not a VisualCore renderer)
gaps.justification: Constitution A02: the fluid solver is an isolated app-domain component with a CPU reference, not a new VisualCore renderer; its equations are product content (artistic model). The reusable machinery it runs on (G-PINGPONG, G-FIELDPASS, G-FLOATRT) is assigned to VisualCore.

gaps.test: PointerVelocityTracker host tests: per-pointer velocity from timestamped samples, multi-touch independence, capped samples per frame and smooth resampling between samples; the app's SplatQueue consumes it

QualityPolicy host tests: tiers map to grid scale, solver iterations and splat cap; thermal 'serious'/'critical' and Low Power Mode step the tier down and recovery steps it up with hysteresis; consumes VisualCoreDiagnostics FramePacing inputs
gaps.justification: Owner moved from VisualCoreSimulation to VisualCoreDiagnostics (feature 021 research R1): the policy consumes FramePacing.Thermal, which lives in Diagnostics; Simulation depends only on Math.

gaps.test: Host tests: FieldGrid shape/difference/padding; StoragePrecision float32/float16 (cross-checked with Float16)/float16TowardZero/unorm8 rounding and the unorm8 stall; SignedRangeEncoding round trip; TimeStepPolicy clamp with invalid deltas. App fixture: GPU dissipation equals the precision-matched CPU reference (max diff 0.0) on iOS 27.2 and 26.5
gaps.justification: Found in A02-P01 (research R6): CPU references for GPU grid passes and precision-matched comparison are generic (A09, A16, A22 need them), so they go to VisualCore per Principle II.

gaps.test: SyntheticGestureScriptTests 11 (determinism, 100 seeds x 600 frames in bounds, began/moved/ended order, strictly increasing timestamps, clamps); app DeterminismTests byte-identical digests on iOS 27.2 and 26.5
gaps.justification: Found in A02-P05 (research R1): seeded, replayable multi-pointer input is needed by every interactive app's fixtures and device runs, so it goes to VisualCore per Principle II; adds the pure edge VisualCoreScenes -> VisualCoreSimulation.

gaps.test: AutomationRunnerTests +4 (seed parsing, check pass with note, check fail, unknown mode unchecked) on both runtimes; ProjectM regression 7/7; app AutomationTests 4
gaps.justification: Found in A02-P05 (research R2-R3): device runs must verify domain invariants and pass a seed; a generic app-supplied post-run check and seed key keep the runner app-neutral.

v0.1 feature 03 — viscosity, dissipation and pressure-iteration quality
v0.1 feature 04 — ink, smoke and glowing-dye palettes

negative.rule: No physically accurate water surface simulation
No unbounded particle emission or background compute
negative.source: manual §2 explicit non-goals; constitution A02 bounded GPU

negative.rule: No ProjectM engine, preset or bridge linkage
No second EGL/ANGLE initialization path or renderer
negative.source: constitution I; manual header rendering invariant

negative.rule: No physical-accuracy or scientific claims; the model is artistic
No device-performance or compatibility claims before campaign II
No VisualCore or ProjectM source changes in Phase 00

reasons: Every capability maps to existing VisualCore API (4 available: feedback, blending/post, pause/reset/seeded, still capture) or an additive gap (6 rows).

All 6 gaps are additive: five reusable VisualCore helpers (PingPongTarget, half-float support query, FieldPass, PointerVelocityTracker, QualityPolicy) owned per Principle II, and the solver equations kept app-local with a CPU reference by the A02 rule. None needs a second renderer, a fork, private API or networking.
Half-float targets are not assumed: support is queried and an RGBA8 fallback is planned (G-FLOATRT), so no unverified GPU feature is a dependency.
Reference regression baseline recorded green 7/7 (T-A02-003) and the empty shell builds and passes its smoke test on both simulator runtimes (T-A02-005).
Phase 01 starts with G-PINGPONG, G-FLOATRT and G-FIELDPASS in VisualCoreRendering and the app's GPU-free solver reference.

A02-P05: MVP-05 (pause, step, reset, deterministic seeded test mode) and MVP-06 (simulation detail) are implemented; the manual's fixtures 1-5 pass as one suite; a 600-frame stress run found and fixed unbounded splats in half-float storage; device stress automation is ready and rehearsed on simulators only (device runs pending the implementation lock).
